scenarios.heading: Common scenarios
scenarios.initializeDescription: Initialize squads, digital workers, SDLC, skills, and executors for the current workspace
scenarios.optimizeDescription: Find recurring failures and unnecessary spending in real workitems.
scenarios.optimizePrompt: Use the squad workflow efficiency and cost optimization skill for a squad in this workspace. Analyze completed workitems from the last 3 days, sampling across days with at most 30 workitems; supplement with recent historical completed workitems when needed. Help me select a squad if I have not specified one. Compare digital worker configuration, SDLC, memory, capabilities and actual execution traces to find recurring efficiency, failure and credits cost issues supported by multiple workitems. Recommend only evidence-backed changes users can maintain, disclose missing data, and accept that no optimization may be warranted. Present evidence, exact changes and validation methods first; apply configuration changes only after I confirm the action plan.
